name: Bloodsucker
body:
You don’t need magical assistance in draining enemies of their blood.

Prerequisite(s): Sanguinai

Benefit(s): You gain the blood drain monster ability, dealing 1d2 Constitution damage to the foe you’re grappling when you end your turn.
